adts: AccountId = [u8; 12] where every byte is an ASCII digit and the value is not 000000000000 for tenant-derived accounts.
Region = AsciiString<1..=63> parsed only from the SigV4 Credential scope; no Host, environment, or implicit default is accepted.
TenantKey = Product<AccountId, Region>; ShardId = Blake3(AccountId || Region || ServiceFamily); ServiceFamily is a closed enum of selected AWS service prefixes.
OpId = Blake3(TenantKey || IdempotencyKey || CanonicalRequestHash); RequestId = Blake3(SigV4 signature prefix || monotonic local counter).
Hlc = Product<WallMillis, LogicalCounter>; FenceToken = monotone u64 carried by LeaseEpoch; Lease = Product<ShardId, EndpointId, LeaseEpoch, FenceToken, ExpiryInstant>.
AuthzCapability = affine Product<EndpointId, OpId, FenceToken, SignatureRef>; it is consumed once and never cloned.
SecretRef = Product<KeychainNamespace, PublicIdentifier>; secret bytes are never represented in AST, CRDT, logs, or responses.
Io<C, A> = Effect<Capability<C>, Result<A, Refusal>>; Reduce is pure and Interpret is the only constructor of Io.
DurableState = Map<ShardId, ShardState>; ShardState = Product<OpLog, LeaseTable, SnapshotRef, ResetEpoch>; join is associative, commutative, and idempotent.
OpRecord = Product<OpId, TenantKey, SmartOp, AuthzCapabilityRef, RequestHash, ResponseHash, Hlc, ParentSet>; all fields are total and serializable.
SnapshotNode = Product<SnapshotRef, ParentSet, iroh_blobs::Hash, StateRootHash, Epoch>; ParentSet contains only previously committed SnapshotRef values.
Refusal = closed sum over Auth, Validation, NoLease, StaleFence, ChecksumMismatch, PhysicalBudgetExceeded, WorkloadFailed, NetworkUnavailable, StorageFailed, TlsFailed, and FidelityBoundary.

consensus_and_cap: There is no Raft, Paxos, Kubernetes controller, or global leader election. Membership is a monotone OR-set with epoch numbers; shard ownership is a deterministic function of the converged sorted EndpointId ring; writes require a current Lease and FenceToken. Under partition, a node without a converged lease refuses writes with Refusal::NoLease, while reads are served from the last verified snapshot. CAP choice is C over A for writes and A over C for reads; after healing, the CRDT union is associative, commutative, and idempotent, so no divergent decision remains. This is physics-bound: measured free bytes, memory, CPU pressure, image-cache bytes, and p99 latency gate placement; no artificial job, credit, or spend cap is introduced.

crate_layout.responsibility: Separate workspace root with resolver 2, shared lints, pinned dependency table, and a release profile tuned for the 7 GiB disk bound. It does not modify the generated aws0 root workspace.
Refinement ADTs, affine capabilities, monadic IO, audit tuples, physical bounds, and zero ambient state. Every cross-crate value is a total, serializable ADT or a capability token.
Small declarative total operation algebra. compile maps an AWS request to one SmartOp; reduce is a pure State x SmartRequest morphism; interpret is the only IO boundary.

Internal strict DAG synchronizer named for the requested iroh-dag-sync substrate. Snapshot nodes reference parent iroh_blobs::Hash values encoded as bytes; the external crate does not exist on crates.io or in n0-computer GitHub, so no phantom dependency is declared.
Durable append-only CRDT log, fencing leases, snapshot metadata, replay cursor, and reset epochs. It owns all persistent logical state and exposes pure joins.

Hidden P2P substrate. It owns three iroh endpoints for data, membership, and ROQ logs; auto DNS discovery; NAT status; local quic-rpc bus; gossip membership; and smol-kv route cache. No user-visible P2P identifier is exported.

Checksum-verified preinstall of laboon, sendme, and OCI image bundles using sendme-compatible BlobTicket transfer and iroh-blobs. Verify and Install are affine typestates; no unverified binary is executed.

Laboon process supervisor for real containers and databases. It owns process handles, ports, mounts, egress policy, health probes, and Drop cleanup. It uses the standalone laboon CLI, not Docker or Kubernetes.
One-port TLS front door. Default is a local certificate authority with no user configuration; optional named-domain mode uses tokio-rustls-acme tls-alpn-01 and DirCache.

Build a MultiServiceRouter from a copied, compile-time selected service closure with per-crate [workspace] Cargo.toml files. It reuses the real InMemoryEngine and generated service crates without editing the generated root workspace or compiling all 440 services.

Parse SigV4 Credential scope, derive AccountId and Region, select a disjoint shard process, and apply a typed projection between 12-digit tenant ARNs and the vendored emulator's fixed 000000000000 account id. This projection is explicitly outside 1:1 AWS parity.

User-facing front door, admin endpoints, AWS service dispatch, and a narrow interception table for operations that require real laboon workloads. It never exposes EndpointId, DocTicket, ALPN, relay URL, lease, or node identity.

Deterministic consistent-hash placement, horizontal scale decisions, lease fencing, migration plans, and measured physical budgets. It uses no global lock, no Kubernetes, and no artificial job or credit caps.
Pure reconciliation from desired CRDT state to observed workload state, then an IO effect that restarts, migrates, drains, or replicates shards. Failover is invisible to the user.
Live witnessed verification and chaos max-load runner. It emits AuditTuple rows with id, sha256, and timestamp; it writes no synthetic test files and accepts no mock implementation as evidence.
Single binary aws0-magic. Zero-argument startup is the one-command user experience; subcommands are for witness, doctor, health, and reset, never P2P configuration.

crdt_design: One iroh_docs::protocol::Docs instance is created with Docs::persistent(path).spawn(endpoint, blobs, gossip), exactly as demonstrated in iroh-docs-0.101.0/examples/setup.rs. A DocsApi owns a Doc per ShardId. Every accepted state-changing request is encoded as postcard OpRecord and written with Doc::set_bytes(author, OpId.as_bytes(), record). The CRDT join is Gamma_t = union(Gamma_(t-1), {CommittedOp}) with OpId as the idempotence key, max(FenceToken) for leases, and last-writer-wins by (Hlc, EndpointId) for route hints. Doc::get_many and Doc::subscribe supply the replay stream and LiveEvent stream. Doc::share and DocTicket join a new node to a namespace without exposing tickets to the user. iroh_blobs::store::fs::FsStore::load holds snapshot collections; iroh_blobs::ticket::BlobTicket, iroh_blobs::format::collection::Collection, and iroh_blobs::get::request::get_hash_seq_and_sizes move snapshots and laboon artifacts. magic-dag-sync stores SnapshotNode values whose ParentSet refers only to already committed SnapshotRef hashes, forming a strict monoidal DAG; compaction is a new snapshot with a proof that every live node has the complete parent prefix, so knowledge is monotone and no truncation occurs. Reset writes a ResetEpoch record and projects the new epoch to empty state; it never deletes history. iroh-smol-kv 0.5.0 holds only ephemeral membership, heartbeat, and route-cache entries via Client::local, Config, WriteScope, Filter, SubscribeMode, SubscribeItem, and SignedValue. Because iroh-docs 0.101.0 depends on iroh-blobs 0.103 and iroh-gossip 0.101.0 while this design pins iroh-blobs 0.105.0 and iroh-gossip 0.103.0, the data endpoint and membership endpoint are distinct iroh::Endpoint values with distinct ALPN byte strings; no Hash, Gossip, or GossipTopic type crosses a semver-incompatible boundary.

invariant_proofs: Idempotence: for every SmartRequest, OpId is the hash of TenantKey, IdempotencyKey, and CanonicalRequestHash; reduce checks set membership before any effect, so f(f(s, op)) = f(s, op). Witness: aws0-magic witness --suite algebra --probe idempotence.

Contention tends to 0 as n tends to infinity: ownership is deterministic per ShardId over a sorted EndpointId ring; each added node owns O(1/n) shards; no global election or global lock exists. Witness: LoadGenerator at three nodes and six nodes with measured lease conflicts equal to zero.

No sycophancy and no 1:1 AWS parity claim: census.md and linkedin-post.txt are cited as measured gaps; the fixed EMULATOR_ACCOUNT_ID projection and the thin selected service set are declared fidelity boundaries in thesis, routing, and risks.

Every exception is handled or propagated: Refusal is a closed enum over authentication, validation, lease, checksum, physical budget, workload, network, storage, and TLS failures; every Result is either converted to a strict AWS-shaped refusal or returned as a typed error; no panic path exists in handlers.

No secrets in AST: SmartRequest and OpRecord contain SecretRef values only; AGENTS.md lines 64-73 rules for root credentials, created credentials, and credential_store().create are preserved; SecretRef is zeroizing and never serialized into CRDT values or logs. Witness: log and CRDT scan for secret material returns zero hits.

No vibe code: every external API in iroh_api_used is tied to a source file actually read; every new type has a crate path and responsibility; every claim is tied to a live witness command. Hand-waving implementation is rejected by the acceptance gate.

Monotone knowledge: Gamma_t is a superset of Gamma_(t-1) because the only log operation is union of CommittedOp values; tombstones are ResetEpoch records, not deletions. Witness: replay prefix hash equality after reset and restart.

State is ADT-isomorphic to pure morphisms: DurableState has no interior mutability; reduce and reconcile are pure functions; interpret is the only IO boundary. Parametric polymorphism over Capability<C> keeps effect separation monadic and lexically scoped.

Entropy is subtractive O(1) cognitive: the user learns one command, one port, one endpoint URL, one 12-digit access key rule, and one region rule; all substrate nouns are absent from the user surface. Witness: a stock AWS CLI with no custom flags completes health, reset, STS, Lambda, and RDS probes.

Topology is a monoidal strict DAG: every CommittedOp points to predecessor OpIds and every SnapshotNode points to committed parent hashes; CycleError is unconstructible for accepted records. Witness: TopologicalCursor rejects injected cycles and accepts only strict prefixes.

Physics is hardware-bounded and CAP-aware: preflight checks free bytes, memory, CPU pressure, image-cache bytes, and p99 budget; writes fail closed without a converged lease, reads use the last verified snapshot. No artificial credit or job cap exists.

Boundaries are affine typestate and Byzantine-tolerant: Capability<Lease> is consumed once, FenceToken rejects stale writers, EndpointId allowlists are checked with iroh::endpoint::Connection::remote_id, and malformed peer records are refused rather than trusted.

Correctness is Pi-type static verification: refinement types constrain AccountId to twelve ASCII digits, Region to SigV4 scope syntax, OpId to 32 bytes, Sha256 to 32 bytes, and FenceToken to a monotone u64; serialization is postcard with total parsers. Witness: property probes over generated boundary values.

Resilience is p99-bounded graceful: FailureDetector uses three missed 250 ms heartbeats, LeaseTtl is two seconds, and P99Probe measures t_new_owner minus t_last_heartbeat; exceeding the configured p99 budget refuses the run rather than claiming success.

Contracts are strict semantics with zero leak: each SmartResponse has one disjoint constructor, each Refusal has one documented wire shape, and no internal P2P state is serialized into an AWS response. Witness: response schema scan over all probes.

ShardId is Blake3(AccountId || Region || ServiceFamily), so disjoint tenants and regions map to disjoint state sets. A Lease carries LeaseEpoch and FenceToken; every Run, Put, Scale, and Heal effect consumes an affine Capability<Lease> and is rejected with Refusal::StaleFence if the token is not current. Adding a node only changes ring ownership for shards whose owner changes; a MigrationPlan streams a verified iroh-blobs snapshot to the new owner and then advances the lease. The only admission limits are PhysicalBudget values measured from free bytes, resident memory, CPU pressure, image-cache bytes, and p99 latency; there are no credit caps, no job-count caps, and no artificial spend gates. Contention tends to 0 as n tends to infinity because each node owns O(1/n) of the shards, there is no global election, and the only shared control structure is the monotone membership OR-set. It emits RestartPlan, MigrationPlan, or DrainPlan; Healer interprets those plans as Io<Capability<Lease>, SelfHealReceipt>. A failed laboon process is restarted with the same WorkloadSpec and state mount. A failed node loses its heartbeat, the deterministic ring assigns a new owner, the new owner streams the latest verified snapshot through iroh-blobs, and the lease advances with a higher FenceToken. Old owners cannot write because every effect consumes the affine capability and checks the fence. Under partition the gateway serves reads from the last verified snapshot and refuses writes with Refusal::NoLease, so the user observes graceful p99-bounded behavior rather than split-brain mutation. All of this is invisible: the AWS API response shape is unchanged and no P2P or membership state is exposed.
smartops_protocol: Smartops is a nine-constructor total operation algebra, not an imperative plugin language. SmartOp has Health(HealthQuery), Reset(ResetEpoch), Put(PutIntent), Get(GetQuery), Run(WorkloadSpec), Scale(ScalePolicy), Heal(HealIntent), Route(RouteIntent), and Snapshot(SnapshotRef). SmartRequest carries scope: SigV4Scope, op_id: OpId, capability: AuthzCapability, and op: SmartOp. SmartResponse is Health(HealthResponse), Reset(ResetResponse), Value(ValueReceipt), Run(RunReceipt), Scale(ScaleDecision), Heal(SelfHealReceipt), Route(RouteReceipt), Snapshot(SnapshotReceipt), or Refused(Refusal). OpAlgebra::compile is total over RequestEnvelope; Reduce::apply is a pure morphism (DurableState, SmartRequest) -> (DurableState, Decision); Decision is Admit, Replay, Refuse, or Effect; Interpret transforms only Effect into Io<Capability<C>, SmartResponse>. Idempotence is f(f(s, op)) = f(s, op) because OpId is Blake3(TenantKey || IdempotencyKey || CanonicalRequestHash) and apply checks membership before any effect. Every exception is a Refusal variant with a strict wire shape; there is no panic path, no ambient state, no implicit region, no global mutable engine, and no hidden mutation. Capabilities are passed lexically and consumed affinely. The user never authors or sees smartops; ordinary AWS operations compile into it and it just works.

CredentialParser only reads the public access key id and Credential scope; it never reconstructs a secret. Every internal SmartRequest carries AuthzCapability with EndpointId, OpId, FenceToken, and SignatureRef; SmartOpsProtocolHandler checks iroh::endpoint::Connection::remote_id against the live EndpointId allowlist before accepting an ALPN stream. Every RPC over quic-rpc repeats the capability check. Capability<Lease> is affine and consumed once. Root credentials from ctx.callback().credentials() are never logged or returned; created credentials use ctx.credential_store().create(&AWS_ACCESS_KEY) and delete(id) as AGENTS.md:64-73 requires. Presigned URLs use ctx.url_signer() and unsigned addresses use ctx.endpoint(), per AGENTS.md:75-85. SecretRef values are zeroizing and never serialized into the AST, CRDT, logs, admin responses, or guest environments. No ambient trust, no implicit account, no implicit region, and no shared static mutable authority exists.
